Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Endless period of time
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Eternity"** means an endless or **infinite period of time. **(अनंत काल)

 
 
• **Example: **Many philosophers ponder the concept of** eternity** and what it means for human existence.
 
 
 
• **"Eternity" **refers to a state of** timelessness**, where time seems to have no beginning or end. (अनंत काल)
 
 
• **Example: **The love stories in literature often speak of a love that lasts for **eternity.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for thee given phrase is '**Eternity**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Longevity **(दीर्घायु): Long duration of life.

 
 
• **Example:** The** longevity **of the ancient tortoise amazed everyone.
 
 
 
• **Impurity **(अशुद्धता): The quality or condition of being impure.
 
 
• **Example: **The water's **impurity** was detected during the quality check.
 
 
 
• **Frailty** (दुर्बलता): The condition of being weak and delicate.
 
 
• **Example:** The **frailty** of the old man was evident as he walked with a cane.
